title: Create issue #10795: Experiencing server-like lagging in singleplayer when applying Tree Fertilizer

text:
[issue by Nono2199]
### Description

Every time I click the Tree fertilizer on a random sapling, my game will "lag" like in multiplayer (not stuttering, FPS is smoothly fine), such as 1) nothing opens/places when right-clicking, and 2) no block breaking when pressing left-click . After like 10-20 seconds, the tree pops up and things return normal.
